caption:
Stop adding onboarding pop-ups. Mario's first level used zero. Comment "LEVEL 1" if your onboarding needs a redesign.

Shigeru Miyamoto built World 1-1 so players would understand the game gradually and naturally, without being told. No manual on screen. Just level design.

3 moves your SaaS onboarding can steal:

1. A safe start: nothing can hurt you in the first seconds
2. One small risk: a single enemy, and you learn to jump
3. One reward: a blinking question block, and curiosity does the rest

Tutorials explain. Level 1 lets people do.

Source: Miyamoto interview via Game Developer (Sept 8, 2015).
